title: Upload failure using `--experimental_remote_cache_async` and flaky test retries

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

labels.name: team-Remote-Exec
labels.description: Issues and PRs for the Execution (Remote) team

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

When using the new `--experimental_remote_cache_async` flag, we get upload failures that don't happen without the flag. It seems to be related to how the test log for flaky tests are generated.
